name: Patagonian fox
desc: A small fox of steppe and scrub. Where it shares ground with the culpeo it eats more rodents and is pushed out of prey-rich areas.
about: The South American gray fox, also known as the Patagonian fox, the chilla or zorro gris, is a South American species of Lycalopex in the Canidae family, which includes dogs, wolves, jackals, coyotes…
